name: The Sunlit
subtitle: Abundance Bracelet · Citrine
promise: Natural honey citrine, warm as late afternoon.
body: Eight-millimetre natural citrine in honey and pale gold, strung without any metal. Traditionally worn for optimism, prosperity and the confidence to say yes. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
seoDescription: Natural citrine bracelet, traditionally worn for abundance and optimism. Last pieces, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day delivery across the UAE.
